column3: Tell me about Ironmen.
When you play as an Ironman, you do everything for yourself. You don't trade with other players, or take their items, or accept their help.
As an Ironman, you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.
If you think you have what it takes, you can choose to become a Hardcore Ironman.

In addition to the standard restrictions, Hardcore Ironmen only have one life. In the event of a dangerous death, your Hardcore Ironmen status will be downgraded to that of a standard Ironman, and your
stats will be frozen on the Hardcore Ironman hiscores.
If you have some friends, you could stand alone... Together, as Group Ironmen. Group Ironmen have the same restrictions as regular Ironmen except you can trade your items with each other!
If you are a daring bunch, you could even try Hardcore Group Ironmen. With Hardcore Group Ironmen you have a set number of lives, when they reach zero, you will become regular Group Ironmen.
If you ever decided to invite experienced players to your group, you would become Unranked Group Ironmen, which are no longer shown on the Group Ironman hiscores.
For the ultimate challenge, you can choose to become an Ultimate Ironman, a game mode inspired by the player IronNoBank.
In addition to the standard restrictions, Ultimate Ironmen are blocked from using the bank, and they drop all their items when they die.
You can choose to become an Ironman while you're on Tutorial Island. Although you can't do that on this account, you might like to bear it in mind for the future.

column3: What changes have been made for this League?
All sorts of things! I can't recount all of the information for you, but I can give you the basics though.
During this League, you are initially restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
Now, for the entire League, you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect!
Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
I think that covers the basics. Would you like to see some more in-depth information?

Not right now.
Fair enough. Is there anything else I can help you with?
How do tasks work?
In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks completed, the more areas available to unlock.
Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
What do these points do?
Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic! These are powerful artefacts to help you in the League.
League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
So how many tasks are there?
More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. With so many to choose from, it's up to you which ones you go for.

Not a problem. Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
Yes, please.
How does the area system work?
In this League, you are initially locked to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
There are nine different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including Misthalin and Karamja, so choose wisely.
The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. However, the other three unlocks are unavailable to begin with.
You can access these additional area unlocks by completing tasks. The more tasks you've completed, the more areas you can unlock.
I see. Thanks!
Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
Yes, please.
How does the area system work?
Relics, or Trailblazer Relics to give them their full name, are powerful artefacts that grant unique abilities for the entire League!
There are eighteen separate Relics, split across six different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier though.
The first Relic tier is available to everyone. However, the higher tiers are locked to begin with.
You can unlock these higher tiers by earning League Points. League Points are earned by completing tasks.
Be warned, you'll need to choose carefully when picking a Relic. Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League.
Anyway, it looks like you have a Relic available for selection right now! Would you like to take a look?
Yes, please.
Tell me about League rewards.
As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Trailblazer Relic tiers you have available.
However, alongside allowing you to unlock Trailblazer Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
What rewards can I buy?
All sorts of things! There's some new furniture for your house, an alternate animation for your Home Teleport spell and some new stylish outfits, just to name a few.
Most of the rewards can be traded with others, so if you want, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.
I see. That all sounds good to me.
Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
One thing to be aware of is that the Trailblazer rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues though.
Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
League Ranks? How do they work?
At the end of the League, you will be given a League Rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
When the League ends, your rank will determine what trophy you get. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
Trophies?
That's right. Trophies are items that are given to you after the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank!
Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one!
League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.

column3: Where would I find polar kebbits?
Funnily enough, you've just put your finger right on the problem. With polar kebbits, finding them is the hardest part! You'll have to track them down.
How would I go about doing that, then?

The easiest way to get started is by looking somewhere you can be sure a kebbit will have been and then working from there. You see the holes around here leading down into the ice? They're kebbit burrows!
You'll be hard pressed to catch a polar kebbit in its home, but if you search around the entrance to a burrow then you might be able to find a trail.

Now, kebbit trails are usually fairly easy to follow once you've found them, but if the trail does peter out, you should try inspecting the surrounding scenery for clues as to where the creature may have gone.
Good places to look for clues include hollow logs in which the kebbit may have hidden or vegetation which may have been chewed or damaged.
There are also tunnels running through the ice here that the kebbits use, so you should check those out as well.
What's more, these tunnels can often help to shelter a trail from further snow, making it even easier for you to pick them up again.
Eventually, of course, the kebbit will have probably hidden somewhere. Polar kebbits don't hang about in the open for long for fear of their natural predators.
If you suspect a kebbit is close by, try looking around for signs of disturbed snow. Polar kebbits will often bury themselves in snow drifts as a means of hiding.
If you think you've found a kebbit, use a noose wand to haul the creature out from the snow.
Wow, that's quite a lot to remember.
Don't worry; if you find yourself struggling to follow a trail, just come and ask me and I'll see if I can help.

column3: How can I improve my chances of capturing a creature?
Ah, the key there is concealment, both of yourself and your traps.
The most obvious point is to stay out of sight of your own traps. If possible, hide around a wall, hedge or similar. Failing that, make sure you're a good few feet away from your trap.
You can hide yourself even better by wearing clothing appropriate to the area in which you are hunting.
Your best bet is to use the skins of creatures native to the area. There is a very good tailor in east Varrock who may be able to help you with making clothing out of such skins.
Finally, a lot of creatures may avoid your traps if they can smell a human scent on them. This is where smoking a trap can be useful.
It takes a bit of practice, but by using the smoke from a torch, you can mask any other scents that may surround a trap.

Deadfall traps basically work by having a large dead weight, such as a boulder, positioned so as to be delicately balanced above some form of bait.
You will need to make sure you have a knife and some wood with you to create appropriate supports and a trigger for this sort trap.
In the case of sabre-toothed kebbits you should use some form of raw meat to bait your trap, but other animals may prefer other baits, such as fish or vegetables.

There are four key factors that will affect your chances: what bait you use, how close to the trap you are, your appearance and your smell.

column3: How does bait help?

Unfortunately, creatures don't just jump into traps for the fun of it nearly as often as we as Hunters might like. However, it is possible to improve those odds. If you can find the right bait to use on your trap,
something your prey really craves, then hunger overrides fear and the creature is just that little bit more likely to bounce to its furry little doom.
Why is it important how close I am to the trap?

However well you might be blending in, if you're standing with your nose pressed right up against your own trap, the poor little critters ain't going to go anywhere near it. So, you need to make sure you put
a sensible distance - I'd say at least four strides - between yourself and your trap.
Why would the creatures care about my appearance?

You're a human. From the point of view of a lot of creatures, you're big and scary. So, it'd be best if the furry little monsters didn't notice you. You need to blend in like the creatures themselves.
And how do I do that?

Easy, dress up like one of them. Even easier, dress up using the furs of the creatures themselves; then you're bound to get the colour right. And, I suppose, if you don't fancy just slinging a dead fur over your
shoulders, you can probably get them made into something more appealing. I hear there are tailors in Varrock who are good at that sort of thing.
What's wrong with my smell!?

I'm sure there's nothing wrong with your smell...from a human point of view. But to your prey, any trap that you've set up will reek of human, and that's going to work against you if you don't do anything about it.
So what should I do?

You need to mask that lovely human scent of yours with something else. Smoke works well. Take a lit torch and waft it around the trap a bit. You'll quickly overpower most of the other smells around the trap.

Well, the equipment isn't too hard to get hold of. You've got specialist shops like Aleck's in Yanille that'll see you right. He's a bit pricey, mind, but it's pretty decent kit.
The clothing is a tad trickier to get hold of, the materials required being rather difficult to seperate from their reluctant owners.
But, if you can get the furs, there are shops like the tailor's in east Varrock that can help you.

Tell me about Zulrah.
Zulrah is the all-powerful snake god of the southern wastes. He rises from the swamp to show his divine majesty and to accept our homage.
Long ago, our forebears came to this place, not realising that they were trespassing in Zulrah's domain. He arose from the swamp in wrath, and many were slain.
But Zulrah, in his mercy, allowed some of those transgressors to live, sparing them the punishment they deserved, and allowing them the chance to repent.
Then my mother, oldest and wisest of the tribe, dared to intercede with the mighty Zulrah on behalf of her people, and thus a sacred contract was declared.
Zulrah granted us the right to dwell in his lands, and to eat of their bounty. None shall ever drive us out, for Zulrah protects us.
All he asks in return is a periodic sacrifice at his sacred shrine. As long as the sacrifices continue, Zulrah will let us live peacefully in his lands.

column3: How do I help you brew 'Rum'?
Well the stills we have set up are based on the ones on Braindeath island... well roughly at any rate.
All you have to do is help put the ingredients into the hoppers and keep the boilers burning.
If you add enough ingredients to the hoppers then you have the ability to pick up a single bottle of rum when it brews.

So, if ye add 5 buckets of water to the hoppers, then ye get access to one bottle. If you add 3 bowls of coloured water you get access to one bottle, and if you add one of anything else you get access to one bottle.
This is cumulative, meaning that if you add (for example) 10 buckets of water, 3 sweetgrubs and 6 bowls of coloured water, then you have a chance to collect 7 bottles of rum for the team.
The boilers are easy as pie to sort out. You just put some logs in, light them with a tinderbox, and then keep putting logs in until they are good and hot.
Three logs should do it, but it's best to keep heaping them in just in case.
The ingredients are; Bitternuts, Scrapey Tree Bark, Sweetgrubs, Buckets of Water and some Coloured Water.

Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god whose name has been forgotten.
The gods became bored and decided to make the mortal races fight for their amusement. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
The war lasted for thousands of years, and millions of goblins died. Eventually, the evil god sent the Dorgeshuun tribe to fight a battle that they could not win.
But General Bloodfist of the Dorgeshuun refused to fight in this battle. Instead, he commanded the Dorgeshuun army to march down into a fissure in the ground.
General Bloodfist stood at the mouth of the fissure and defied the might of the evil god.
The evil god smote him with a mighty blast that shook the earth, but that blast also closed the fissure, sealing the Dorgeshuun away from the reach of the gods.
Lieutenant Strongaxe, now the leader of the Dorgeshuun, led the tribe deeper into the caves. They found this cavern, and here they founded Dorgesh-Kaan, city of the Dorgeshuun.
Can you tell me about the Dorgeshuun civil war?
Certainly! *Ahem*
At first, Dorgesh-Kaan was ruled over by generals, just as the tribe had been when it was on the surface. Each general succeeded the last by defeating him in combat.
The generals were advised by a council of elders, but the Dorgeshuun were no longer an army, and many of the people felt that the Council should have authority.
The people voted to become a republic, but General Bonehelm refused to give up power, and so the Dorgeshuun Civil War began.
The republican faction was larger, but the military faction contained most of the trained warriors and controlled the magical equipment that the tribe had brought from the surface.
General Bonehelm was driven from the city, but dug his own base out of the caves nearby.
General Bonehelm's army attacked the city using archers mounted on giant frogs. There was a bloody battle, and General Bonehelm was driven back again into his base.
But General Bonehelm's mining had weakened the stone around his base, and the retreating army's footsteps caused the roof to collapse, crushing his army.
That was the last time one Dorgeshuun has raised arms against another. Since then, the city has been ruled peacefully by an elected council.

In the Era of Kings, many centuries ago, it was harder of course. Our steam technology was not developed as far yet and getting fresh supplies of food was always a problem.

We dwarves went underground a long time ago, see. For a while the city of Keldagrim was completely cut off from the rest of Gielinor simply waiting out the wars of the humans and the gods.
This made it hard, though, to determine when the wars above the ground were over. Perhaps Keldagrim had remained hidden for far too long.
Only when King Alvis heroically defended the city against an invasion of trolls did we dare to venture out and see how much the world had changed.
Of course, after that...
Ah well, enough history lessons I should say. I must really get back to my gardening.

column3: What's the difference between an easy and a hard job?

The foods that you need to cook for the easy jobs are more straight forward than the hard ones, and the customers will be within the Gnome Stronghold, or one of the Gnome Glider Pilots on duty. You will get one
credit for completing a delivery, and the tips you get will be a small amount of cash.

The hard jobs could require you to cook any piece of gnome cuisine or cocktail. The customers could be anywhere in Gielinor, If you are going to complete the delivery in time, you'll probably have to use some form
of transport. Gnome gliders are especially useful here.

For the hard jobs you will be given more time to complete the delivery though. You get three credits for completing it, and the tips you get tend to be useful objects, and even a few unusual items, that you won't
be able to get hold of anywhere else!
What are these free delivery tokens?

I'll give you a free delivery token when you earn 12 credits. You can then use the token to make a food order yourself! This is a great privilege, we normally only deliver to gnomes. You may only have one token
at a time, and they are non-transferrable.

If you gain more credits then for every 12 extra credits you earn, you will receive an extra item of food or drink per delivery, up to a maximum of ten items. You can continue to make deliveries after this, but you
will not get any more credits - just the normal tip and cooking training.
Once you call for a delivery your token will be used up, and you'll have to earn another one, if you want another delivery.
Will this help me with my cooking?
You will be able to develop your cooking skills during deliveries - you'll get the normal training for making the items, but also a bonus for successfully delivering the goods.

Tell me about it...
It's a bit hot and dry round here for a gnome isn't it? I thought you gnomes liked your home comforts.
Certainly I miss home cooking, but gnomes are also fundamentally curious people. I'm here exploring the furthest reaches of the world for the King.
Found anything interesting?

Sophanem is a curious place, if you can get into the blighted place. There are several pyramids round here as well. Fascinating architecture, I've heard stories that some of them contain treasure tombs and mummies.
Cats seem to have considerable importance round here, they certainly seem tied into their religion. The Gods round here seem very alien to me - I've never heard of them before.
Thanks.
Are you hunting animals, then?
I'm exploring the region for the good of the gnome people.
You're not tracking down huge beasts to kill - you look equipped for it.
Well, if I find anything interesting I'll try and bring it back to the King. That might include animals, I suppose. I'd rather not kill it, though - most animals are more useful alive.
How would you get it home, then?
Never underestimate the ingenuity of a gnome, friend.
Have you found anything else interesting around here?

I've heard strange rumours about something the locals call the Broodoo. I haven't quite worked out what they are but they seem to be some sort of undead whose ghastly fate depends on the way they were killed.
I think they may be sacrifice victims - but I'm not sure why they are sacrificed. Either way the locals seem to be very scared of them.
That's interesting. Thanks.
I can't believe that I've been made to wait so long.
What are you waiting for?
I have been waiting for an audience with the King for days!
Well, he's clearly a busy man.
Bah! I think he's just trying to insult the gnome nation, by making me wait. The cheek of these humans. Just because they're vertically challenged they think they can ignore us.
I'm not ignoring you.
Hmm. I should be thankful for small mercies, I suppose.
It's all very bright round here, isn't it?
Well, it is the White Knights' Castle.
I think it would all look better in a nice dark green. At least then I wouldn't be squinting all the time.
Yes, but then they'd have to become the Dark Green Knights. Doesn't really have the same ring to it.
Bah, humans have no sense of style...
Hello Ambassador. Are you here visiting King Roald?
Well, in theory, but he always seems to be busy.
You don't seem that upset by that, though...
Oh no, I like travelling, and if you become a diplomat patience is a vital skill.
I'll try to remember that.
Fascinating, fascinating. It's remarkable what these young dwarves have managed to create. Oh, hello young man.
Hello, what's a gnome like you doing in a place like this?
Ah, well I have been sent by King to talk with the dwarves here and find out more about their recent advances in technology.
Found anything interesting?
The rideable carts are a very handy way to get to mining sites, and the Blast Furnace is a magnificent beast of a machine.
I'll have a look, thanks.
Hiya! Do you want to buy me a drink?
I think I'll pass on that.
Fine, I'm sure somebody else round here will know how to treat a woman...
Do you live here too?
Oh no, I come from the Gnome Stronghold. I've been sent here by King Narnode to learn about human magics.
So where's this Gnome Stronghold?
It's in the North West of the continent - a long way away. You should visit us there some time. The food's great, and the company's delightful.
I'll try and make time for it. Sounds like a nice place.
Well, it's full of gnomes. How much nicer could it be?
I didn't realise gnomes were interested in magic.
Gnomes are interested in everything, lad.
Of course.
We have a saying, 'Curiosity killed the cat'. But cats aren't clever enough to understand what they find. Gnomes are.
Ooh, lovely view, dear.
Yes dear.
I hope the food's better here than it was last time.
I'm sure it will be, dear.
Sorry to disturb you, but what are you two doing here?
Perrdur and I are having a nice romantic dinner, aren't we dear?
We are celebrating the anniversary of our marriage, aren't we dear?
Yes dear.
And we are having a very enjoyable time, aren't we dear?
Yes dear.
Clearly. I'll let you two lovebirds carry on, then.
Hello?
Hello there. Can I do anything for you?
No I'm fine, I'm just wandering around.
Ooh, I'm all dizzy...
Why's that?
Well, watching that wheel go round and round and round...
and round and round and round...
Looks like you need a bit of a rest.
and round and round and round again...
See you around!
Very funny.
Hello, what are you doing here, so far from home?
I'm enjoyn' the local hoschpitalieee. hee hee.
Looks like you've enjoyed more than your fair share of hospitality.
tee hee, I probblie schoodn' 'av anuva drinkie right now. But dis dwarven beer ish kind of moreish after the fiff pint.
I'd go easy on the dwarven stout if I were you.
I yousht to be a tesht pilot yoo know. I reeel hero.
But I loscht my bottle. Scho I now ffind scholiss in the bottle.
What happened? Did you have a glider crash or get attacked by huge flying birds or something?
Naaah, I realished I woz scared ov heightsh.
Ah, I can see that would be a problem ... You should keep an eye on your drinking, though.
I'll try. Bofe eyez...
Hello old chap.
What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be looking after your glider?
I'm pretty much retired these days old fellow. My test piloting days are over. I'm just relaxing here and enjoying the primal clash between man and man.
You're watching the duels then. Are you going to challenge someone yourself?
I do find the duels entertaining to watch, but I suspect that actually being involved would be a lot less fun for me. I'm a lover, not a fighter!
Errm, I suppose you are.
So what do you do?
I breed Terrorbirds.
Why are they called Terrorbirds?
Well, they're supposed to look terrifying but I think they are rather cute.
I'm sure they are cute, unless they are biting your arm off.
Oh they'd never do that - unless I tell them to, of course.
I'd better stay on your good side then!
Gah! You play like a donkey, don't just sit there, get up and get the ball back!
Hello?
That's more like it, get in there!
Excuse me?
Oof. That's got to hurt.
You think this guy is far too engrossed in the sport to pay any attention to anything else.
This gnome lady appears to be singing ... to her toads.
La La La, toadies in their holeys! .. Oh hello, I didn't notice you.
Hello, What do you do here?
I look after the toads and worms. They are very useful in gnome cooking, don't you know.
Does singing to the toads help them grow?
Don't be silly, I just sing to pass the time while looking after them!
Of course...
Good day. What are you up to?
My job is to ensure that everyone can use the bank safely. Shifty types always hang around banks, you know.
You're not shifty, are you?
No, of course not.
Jolly good. Carry on then.
Hello.
Be vigilant, citizen.
Err, right.
Pretty Trees!
Having fun?
I'm just looking at the magic trees. I think they're cool.
Well, they are magical. Valuable as well...
When I grow up I want to chop down trees and make magic bows. Then I'd be rich.
Well, that does seem to be a common career around here.
Greetings traveller.

Abbot Langley places his hands on your head. You feel a little better.

We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!
I might be able to... What did you have in mind?
Can you remove the sigils from my spirit shields?
I think I shoud be able to manage that. However in doing so, I'm afraid I'll have to destroy the blessed shield itself. You'll only get the sigil back.
I can go ahead and break down all of the shields in your inventory now if you'd like?.
Abbot Langley carefully breaks each shield, leaving the sigils perfectly intact.
Not right now.

The Skillcape of Prayer is the hardest of all the skillcapes to get; it requires much devotion to acquire but also imbues the wearer with the ability to briefly fly!
The Cape of Prayer also increases the amount of Prayer points restored from drinking potions when it is equipped. Is there something else I can do for you?

column6: Could you teleport me to the Abyss?

column3: Let's see what you're selling.
Could you teleport me to the Abyss?
Veniens! Sallakar! Rinnesset!
Alright, I'll go.
Hello there.
Quiet! You must not break my concentration!

column8: I need your help with something.

column3: Why not?
Well, if my concentration is broken while keeping this rift open, the results won't be pretty.
In what way?
If we are lucky, the heads of anyone within the Abyss will suddenly explode, including us.
Err... And if we're unlucky?
If we are unlucky, then the entire universe will begin to fold in upon itself, and all reality as we know it will be annihilated in a single stroke.
So leave me alone!
What are you doing here?
Do you mean what am I doing here in the Abyss? Or are you asking me what I consider my ultimate role to be in this voyage that we call life?
Err... The first one.
By remaining here and holding this rift open, I am providing a permanent link between normal space and this strange dimension.
As long as my spell remains in effect, we have the capability to teleport into the Abyss.
Now leave me be! I can afford no distraction in my task!
I need your help with something.
What? Oh... very well. What did you want?

column6: Can I have a new essence pouch?

Don't waste my time if you don't have enough free space to take it.

Fine. A simple transfiguration spell should resolve things for you.
Thanks.
Now can you leave me alone? I can't keep affording these distractions!
Actually, I don't need anything right now.
Then go away! Honestly, you have no idea of the pressure I am under. I can't afford any distractions!
Sorry, I'll go.
Good. I'm attempting to subdue the elemental mechanisms of the universe to my will. Inane chatter from random idiots is not helping me achieve this!
Are you all right? You seem a little...incoherent.
Inc'hearnt? Inc'herant! You...you...with yer fancy book- lernin' words. You'd be more than inc'herant if youd seen...
(Dramatic pause)
THEM!

column4: I'm sure I would as well.

column3: I'm sure I would as well.
I'm going over here to talk to non-crazy people now.
Yeah? Yeah? Well when THEY come floppin' into your house and eat your furniture you'll be sorry!
Who are
(Dramatic pause)
THEY?
They! Those bloodthirsty, flesh-tearing devils! They are the reason I'm out here every day hurlin' bottles into the sea!
They are the reason I've lost everything, except the horrifying memory of what THEY look like...
And what do THEY look like?
Mudskippers!
Mudskippers?
Aye, Mudskippers! Those ferocious, ravening, evil, beady-eyed terrors of the deep!
I...see...
I was ambushed by them way back, see. They got the drop on me...I can't remember where, somewhere around here though.
These would be the mudskippers, right?
Aye! The mudskippers! Huge they were! Ten feet of glistening, muddy flesh floppin' towards me with white foam flying from their gnashing fangs!
I fought them up and down the beach, with the tide rising and more of them leaping towards me with cutlasses drawn!
This is fascinating, but I have to be...
Shut yer' word-hole and listen! I can't remember all the details, as I'm sure they must have hit me quite hard, but the last thing I remember before it all went black...
...was one of those devils rearing over me, its eyes glowin' red with the fires of hell!
Fires of hell...right. I believe you.
No you don't! You think I'm crazy, like all the rest! Well, if I'm crazy, how did I get these?
Get what?
Skippy shows you what appears to be massive bite scars on his legs. You're no expert, but they look like... giant mudskipper bites!
Giant mudskipper bites! Where did you get those?
I can't remember... I've been drinking to forget the horror, and all I seem to have forgotten is where it all happened...
Hmmm...I suppose if I sober you up you may well start to recall.
You'll have a job. I've been drinking this for a week.
'Captain Braindeath's Extra Strength Rum/Drain Cleaner. Now 50% more debilitating'?
It's the extra sheep tranquilizers that gives it that added kick!
Stay here and I'll be right back. Try not to move. Or go near any open flames.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
Good day, how may I help you?

column6: I'd like to check my PIN settings.

We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
Miaoww
Good day.
I have no interest in speaking with you. You should bring your cat to me again. The two of us have much to discuss.
Hello.
Well hello there. Are you hungry? If so you've come to the right place. Eat green, eat gnome cuisine. My waiter will be glad to take your order.
Thanks.
On the other hand, if you're looking for some gnome cooking training, this is also the place to be. My son Lufty is looking for staff at the moment.

column6: Ok, I'll give it a go.

column3: No thank, I'm no cook.
In that case, please eat and enjoy.
Ok, I'll give it a go.
Well that's great. I'm Aluft Gianne, owner of this restaurant, and you are...?
Most people call me {name}.
Really? Sorry, how rude of me. It just takes a little while to get used to the funny names you humans have.
Of course if you're going to work for me I'll have to see what you're like first. Here, take a look at our menu.
Hello.
Hello sir, can I tempt you with any of the dishes on our new menu?
I'll take a look.

I hope you like what you see. Although all these premade dishes are good to eat - they were made by the last human assistant chef. He wasn't up to Chef's exacting standards - and you may find that they will
not be accepted by some people as the 'real' thing.
Not really.
That's your choice sir, enjoy your stay.
Hello, welcome to the Cooking Guild. Only accomplished chefs and cooks are allowed in here. Feel free to use any of our facilities.
Nice cape, you're wearing!
Thank you! It's my most prized possession, it's a Skillcape of Cooking; it shows that I've achieved level 99 Cooking and am one of the best chefs in the land!
If you ever achieve level 99 cooking you'll get to wear one too and doing so means you'll never burn any food!
Thanks, bye.

Hello there!
Hello, what's in those boxes?
Aha, interested in my crossbows are you?
Are they any good?

They're dwarven engineering at its best. If you've got enough skill in crafting, smithing and fletching, you can even make them yourself. You can buy some of the parts here and make the rest yourself.

column4: How do I make one for myself?

column3: How do I make one for myself?
Well, firstly you'll need to chop yourself some wood, then use a knife on the wood to whittle out a nice crossbow stock like these here.
Wood fletched into stock... check.

Then get yourself some metal and a hammer and smith yourself some limbs for the bow, mind that you use the right metals and woods though as some wood is too light to use with some metal and vice versa.
Which goes with which?
Wood and Bronze as they're basic materials, Oak and Blurite, Willow and Iron, Steel and Teak, Mithril and Maple, Adamantite and Mahogany and finally Runite and Yew.
Ok, so I have my stock and a pair of limbs... what now?

Simply take a hammer and smack the limbs firmly onto the stock. You'll then need a string, only they're not the same as normal bows. You'll need to dry some large animal's meat to get sinew, then spin that on a spinning
wheel, it's the only thing we've found to be strong enough for a crossbow.
What about magic logs?

Well.. I don't rightly know... us dwarves don't work with magic, we prefer gold and rock. Much more stable. I guess you could ask the humans at the rangers guild to see if they can do something but I don't want
anything to do with it!
Thanks for telling me. Bye!
Take care, straight shooting.
What about ammo?

You can smith yourself lots of different bolts, don't forget to flight them with feathers like you do arrows though. You can poison any untipped bolt but there's also the option of tipping them with gems then
enchanting them with runes. This can have some pretty powerful effects.
Oh my poor bank, how will I store all those?!
Don't you worry, I have just the thing here, a bolt pouch designed specially for holding 4 different types of crossbow bolt.
Wow, how much?
Well let's see now... for you? 1500 gold pieces should do the trick.
Yes I'll pay the 1500gp.
Hand it over then.
Oh, I don't have that much on me.
Best go make some money then, shouldn't take you too long.
Thanks for telling me. Bye!

Welcome to the church of holy Saradomin.

He who creates the forces of goodness and purity in this world? I cannot believe your ignorance!
This is the god with more followers than any other! ...At least in this part of the world.
He who created this world along with his brothers Guthix and Zamorak?

column6: Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.

Yeah... I, uh, thought you said something else.
Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.
That's... strange.
I thought things not from this world were all... You know. Slime and tentacles.

column4: You don't understand. This is an online game!
column6: I am - do you like my disguise?

Aargh! Avaunt foul creature from another dimension! Avaunt! Begone in the name of Saradomin!
Ok, ok, I was only joking...
Nice place you've got here.

column3: How do I set my PIN?

You can set your PIN by talking to any banker, they will allow you to access your bank pin settings. Here you can choose to set your pin and recovery delay. Remember not to set it to anything personal such as
your real life bank PIN or birthday.

The recovery delay is to protect your banked items from account thieves. If someone stole your account and asked to have the PIN deleted, they would have to wait a few days before accessing your bank account to
steal your items. This will give you time to recover your account.
There will also be a delay in actually setting the PIN to be used, this is so that if your account is stolen and a PIN set, you can cancel it before it comes into use!
How do I remove my PIN?

Talking to any banker will enable you to access your PIN settings. There you can cancel or change your PIN, but you will need to wait for your recovery delay to expire to be able to access your bank. This
can be set in the settings page and will protect your items should your account be stolen.
What happens if I forget my PIN?

If you find yourself faced with the PIN keypad and you don't know the PIN, just look on the right-hand side for a button marked 'I don't know it'. Click this button. Your PIN will be deleted (after a delay of a
few days) and you'll be able to use your bank as before. You may still use the bank deposit box without your PIN.

You can participate in Duels and Tournaments. These may be ranked, if you want rewards and prestige, or unranked if you're just fighting your friends for fun.
This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Within it you'll find the PvP Arena options.

Win or lose, you'll earn Reward Points for taking part in ranked Duels and Tournaments. You can trade your points here for supplies that might help in the Wilderness, or such places.
Now, if you want to choose your opponents, you can have an unranked Duel or Tournament instead, just for the fun of beating them.
Use the recruitment boards outside the hospital to set up your own unranked tournament, or to apply to an existing one.
For an unranked Duel, look around the Arena for someone you wish to fight, and challenge them...
You'll see a 'Challenge' option when you right-click other people around the Arena. Use that to set up an unranked Duel.

Generally you would find onions in vegetable gardens, silly.
Ok you have me there but is there anywhere around here where I could get my hands on some onions?
I really don't know. A friend of mine grows hers on a farms near Draynor village. But that's a little far from here to be useful.
What do you need to make blue dye?
To make a bottle of blue dye I'll need 2 woad leaves and 25 coins from you.

column4: Okay, make me some blue dye please.
column6: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
column8: I can do without dye at that price.
column10: Where can I get some woad leaves?

column3: You don't have enough woad leaves to make the blue dye.
Where can I get some woad leaves?
Woad leaves are fairly rare. My other customers tell me there's a gardener in Falador who grows them.
On second thoughts, I don't think that I need some dye right now.
How did you get into the colour business?
Well, it's quite simple reallymissing comma my mother was a drysalter and I learnt the trade from her.
Umm, what's a drysalter, it isn't a medical condition is it?
No silly, it's someone who deals with preservatives and dyes. I didn't really enjoy the preservative side of things so I've chosen to deal solely in dyeing.
So how's business then?
It's a dyeing trade! Oh gosh, I'm sorry, that was a truly dreadful joke.
Hmm yes, about the worst I've heard today at least.
Thanks. But really, it's not the best around here, nearly everyone in this town wears only white, which means I don't exactly do a roaring trade. Now is there anything I can get you?

column4: Could you make some dye for me please?
column6: No thanks, I'm just having a look around.

column3: No thanks, I'm just having a look around.
I thought I killed you?!
Ha! Ha! Ha!
You can not kill me human!
I've lost the pendant you gave me.
Have another, it will remind you of my power!
I have defeated Lucien!
Well done friend! He will not be able to return for a while, this is good news!
Can I have another pendant?
The guardian gives you another pendant.
Cheers. Catch you later.
See you around.
Hi again. Could you do the honours again please?
Certainly! We helps those that helps poor Winelda!
Hello there.
Wooo? Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Hello.
You ssshould not be down here...
Who are you?
My name isss unimportant... I live only to ssserve my massster.
Um... Okay then.
Why are you down here?
Thisss isss where I belong... Beingsss sssuch as myssself cannot abide in the light... It is in the darknesss where we find our homesss...
Uh... Okay then.
Can I use your anvil?
Of courssse you may... I have very little ussse for it nowadaysss...
Uh... Thanks, I guess.
I feel a little sea-sick from this travelling.
Well there's a good remedy for that.
There is?
Yes.
What?
Swim.
Oh HA HA. Thanks for the help!
My pleasure.
I was being sarcastic.
I know. So was I.
I have some good news. Count Draynor is no more!
He's really gone? Finally, we can live without fear! Thank you, thank you! You're a true hero!
I'm happy to have helped.
Buy me a drink pleassh...
I think you've had enough.
Hi there.
All is lost!
Sorry?
Don't bother, you're not experienced enough to help me!
Leave me be.
wooo wooo
Excuse me..
Leave me or I'll destroy you!
Good day.
Good day to you sir.
Hello youngster!
I don't talk to strange old people.
Hey who you calling old?! And strange?!
Hello youngster!
The child is too busy playing to take any notice.
Hello there.
Oh hello, I'm sorry, I'm a bit worn out.
Busy day?
Oh, It's those mice! They're everywhere! What I really need is a cat. But they're hard to come by nowadays.
No, you're right, you don't see many around.
Augh! Your sins! They BLIND me!
Whoooo wooo Whooooooooo.
You knock at the door. You hear a voice from inside...
Yes? What do you want?

column6: Have you ever thought about letting Saradomin into your life?
column8: Can I interest you in some double glazing?
column10: Would you like to buy some lucky heather?

column3: Pizza delivery!
We didn't order any Pizza. Get lost!
It looks like you'll have to find another way in...
Have you ever considered letting the glory of Saradomin into your life? I have some pamphlets you may be interested in reading and discussing with me.
No. Go away.
It looks like you'll have to find another way in...
Can I interest you in some double glazing? An old castle like this must get very draughty in the winter...
No. Get out of here before I run you through.
It looks like you'll have to find another way in...
Would you like to buy some lucky heather?
No. Go away.
It looks like you'll have to find another way in...
Greetings! I am Sir Lancelot, the greatest Knight in the land! What do you want?

column4: You're a little full of yourself aren't you?

column3: You're a little full of yourself aren't you?
I have every right to be proud of myself.
My prowess in battle is world renowned!
I seek a quest!
Leave questing to the professionals.
Such as myself.
Good day to you!

column6: Know you of any quests sir knight?

column3: Good day.
Know you of any quests sir knight?
The king is the man to talk to if you want a quest.
Good morrow!
Morning. Know where an adventurer has to go to find a quest around here?
An adventurer eh? There is no service finer than serving the bountiful King Arthur, and I happen to know there's an important quest to fulfill.
May I help you?
I'm really just looking for a quest...
Fortune favours us both then adventurer. I suggest you go and speak to King Arthur.
Hail Arthur, King of the Britons!
Um... Hello.
I'm looking for adventure! More specifically, some sort of quest.
...Then hail Arthur, King of Britons, like I just said.
Oh. Ok.
I thought you just had a weird way of saying hello is all.
Greetings to the court of King Arthur!
Hello. I'm looking for a quest. Who should I talk to?
King Arthur will let you know. I believe he has a quest at the moment.
Hello there adventurer.
I'm looking for a quest...
Talk to the King then adventurer. He is always looking for men of bravery to aid him in his actions.
Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?
I'd like some advice on finding a quest.
I do not know of any myself... but it would perhaps be worth your while asking the King if he has any tasks for you.
Congratulations, brave knight, on aiding Camelot in so many ways! If we ever require help again, I will make sure to call upon you!
Thanks!
Good day to you sir.
Who are you?
I am the Lady of the Lake.
Good day.
Welcome to my court. I am King Arthur of the Knights of the Round Table.

column4: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!
column6: So what are you doing in Gielinor?

column3: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!
Really? Well then you will need to go on a quest to prove yourself worthy. My knights all appreciate a good quest.

Unfortunately, our current quest is to rescue Merlin. He recently got himself trapped in some sort of magical crystal. We've moved him from the cave we found him in and now he's upstairs in his tower.
I will see what I can do then.
Talk to my knights if you need any help.
I may come back and try that later.
Be sure that you come speak to me soon then.
So what are you doing in Gielinor?
Well legend says we will return to Britain in its time of greatest need. But that's not for quite a while yet.
So we've moved the whole outfit here for now.
We're passing the time in Gielinor!
Thank you very much.
Hello, my friend. Have a look at my wares.
No, I'm really too busy.
Ahh, a kind stranger. Get this old man another drink so that he may wet his throat and talk to you.
Hello there.
Good day. Can I help you with anything?

column4: Yes, I'd like a drink please.
column8: The 'Asp and Snake'? What a strange name for a bar.

column3: Yes, I'd like a drink please.
What's going on in town?
Nothing much really. About what you'd expect from a sleepy little town like ours.
What about those two gangs? That seems exciting.
They're paying customers, so I won't rock the boat if you don't mind.
Is there anything else I can help you with?

column6: Yes, I'd like to talk about something else.

column3: No thanks, I'm ok. Thanks for your time.
The 'Asp and Snake'? What a strange name for a bar.
Maybe around these parts. Were you expecting it to have 'Ali' in the name?
I did think about calling it 'Ali's', but then it'd get confused with the Camel Shop, the Kebab House, the Mayor's residence...
Yes, I get your point. It's a perfectly fine name.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
Hello.
Hello. What can I do for you?
I don't know, what can you do for me?
Well, that depends.
Depends on what?
It depends on whether you like kebabs or not.
Why is that?
Seeing as I'm in the kebab construction industry, I mainly help people in need of a kebab.
Well then, what kind of kebabs do you, er, construct?

I offer two different types of kebabs: the standard run- of-the-mill kebab seen throughout Gielinor and enjoyed by many an intoxicated dwarf, and my speciality, the extra-hot kebab. So which shall it be?

column4: I want a standard kebab, please.
column6: Could I have an extra-hot kebab please?
column8: Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
column10: What is the difference between the standard and the extra-hot kebab?

column3: I want a standard kebab, please.
That will be three gold coins.
I seem to be short on coins. Sorry.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
Could I have one of those crazy hot kebabs of yours?
One super kebab coming up! Be careful, they really are as hot as they're made out to be.
Sure, sure.
I seem to be short on coins. Sorry.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
Well, that depends. What do you intend to do with it?
Don't worry, I've no intention of setting up a rival kebab shop.
But then what do you want it for?
I don't know, but I think I could have a little bit of fun with it.
You're not going to put it in Drunken Ali's drink, are you? That's what happened the last time I gave someone the sauce.
No, that would be a bit cliché. I think I'll come up with something more original.
What is the difference between the standard and the extra-hot kebab?

If I told you that I would have to kill you. Kebab construction is a cut-throat industry. The extra-hot kebab gives me my competitive edge and if I were to divulge my secrets to every passing adventurer, I'd
soon be out of business.
So there's no difference except the sauce you use?
Shh! Keep your voice down. You should have told me you were from the union.

column6: Could I have an extra-hot kebab please?
column8: Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
column10: Listen I've got to run. I'll catch you later.

column3: Listen, I've got to run. I'll catch you later.
I need some information.

If information is what you need, there are many better people to ask than myself who could help you. One of the town's street urchins or perhaps the local drunk. I may be many things to many different people, but a
gossip I am not.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
Greetings! Are you in need of provisions?
No thanks.
Welcome to my discount camel store. Can I help you with anything?

column10: I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.

column3: A discount camel store?
Yes - it's my great idea - selling camels at discounted prices so that the common man can experience the joys of owning a camel of their very own! They're not just a source of kebab meat you know!

column4: So can I buy a camel then? I'm hungry!
column8: Why would I want a camel? All they do is spit and...
column10: Actually, I think I was a camel in a previous life.
column12: So is the discount camel business good then?

column3: So can I buy a camel then? I'm hungry!
I would never sell one to the likes of you! They are beautiful, majestic creatures, not food! Get out of my shop.
Yes, camels are beautiful creatures.
Ah, wondrous camels! Best of all Saradomin's creations. Ships of the desert, far more useful than any horse or donkey. Truly, they are a man's best friend.
Perhaps you'd like a camel of your own? You're in the right place, if so...
Is there anything else I can help you with?

column4: Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
column6: No but thanks for your time.

column3: No but thanks for your time.
Why would I want a camel? All they do is spit and...
Pah! I've seen mummies with more brains than you! If you treat camels badly then of course they're going to spit at you. May your robes never be clean again!
Is there anything else I can help you with?

column4: Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
column6: No but thanks for your time.

column3: Actually, I think I was a camel in a previous life.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

column4: Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
column6: No but thanks for your time.

Business is booming! Pollnivneach has never seen this number of visitors.
In fact I'm thinking of expanding and trying to break into the camel hire market.
If only I could figure out how to get people to return the camels...
Is there anything else I can help you with?

column4: Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
column6: No but thanks for your time.

column3: Tell me about this town.
Well, Pollnivneach is a funny little place. It's a small town and you'd think it'd be nice and quiet.
But those Menaphites and bandits are making the place quite unbearable.

column6: Well the weak will always be trodden on. Why not stand up to them?

column3: In what way?
Well, one group is as bad as the other! They steal, they fight, they cause trouble with us locals. Just yesterday one of those bandits came looking for protection money!
Why don't the authorities stop this?
We're a small town. We don't have the resources to keep the gangs off our backs! Menaphos and Al Kharid are no help either.
To tell the truth we live in hope that an outsider, someone with no ties to either group, could broker a deal to halt the hostilities between them.
Hmm...
Is there anything else I can help you with?

column4: Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
column6: No but thanks for your time.

You might think about that. Anyway, isn't it the job of the brave adventurer to protect the weak and innocent from evil and harm?
Is there anything else I can help you with?

column4: Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
column6: No but thanks for your time.

Yes, perhaps you could.
You know the politics better than I do. What do you recommend?
Me?! I am but a humble discount camel seller. You're the adventurer, don't you know what to do?

column4: Indeed I should know, and indeed I do! I was just testing you!
column6: Perhaps I should know, but offered advice should never be shunned.

That is reassuring to hear. Too often one meets brainless adventurers whose solution to every problem is to hack, maim and murder.
I'm glad to know you're not of that ilk.
Is there anything else I can help you with?

column4: Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
column6: No but thanks for your time.

But fine, I'll give you a hint. Try and see if you can get the gangs to agree to a truce by offering them each a token gift as an act of reconciliation.
If that fails to work, you must consider trying to influence the gangs from within.
Is there anything else I can help you with?

column4: Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
column6: No but thanks for your time.

column3: Lovely day isn't it?
It's a beautiful day today, but word has it that it will rain tomorrow.
Really?
No! When have you ever known it to rain here in Gielinor?
Oh. Anyway...
Is there anything else I can help you with?

column4: Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
column6: No but thanks for your time.

column3: I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
Well you've found your man.
Really do you have an uncle called Ali?
Why yes - all my uncles are called Ali!
Oh dear! Do any of them own a stall in the Al Kharid Bazaar?
Well no, but one of them owns a camel hire franchise.
Never mind.
Hello there little fellow.
I'm not little and if you say that again I'll gut you.
Easy there, I didn't mean to offend.
I'll let you off this once. Well what do you want? Information?
Yes, tell me about...
Tell me about the Menaphites.

They're a bad bunch, always starting fights down in the Asp and Snake. Word on the street is that they're led by some deranged priest. Nobody's ever seen them though - they do all their deals through Ali 'the
Operator'. I reckon they're up to something, but they're such a close knit group that little ever slips out.
Do you need any other information?
Yes, tell me about...
No thanks.
Come back if you need any info about anything in the town.
I will do thanks.
Tell me about the bandits.
There's not much to say, really. They're just a group of local thugs led by the biggest and strongest amongst them. If they have any other plans, I don't know about it.
Do you need any other information?
Tell me about the Mayor.

The mayor is a spineless coward! He never stands up to anybody. That's why the Menaphites are so strong now! He let them stay, and then they started causing trouble. When he realised his mistake, he hired a band
of local thugs to drive them out, but they saw how weak he was and turned on us too. Now we've got bandits and Menaphites, and the mayor isn't doing anything!
Do you need any other information?
Tell me about the town.
It's boring! We're not as big as Menaphos or as powerful as Al Kharid, and we've got a really nasty crime problem. It's no wonder so many grown-ups have left.
Do you need any other information?
Welcome, adventurer, to the town of Pollnivneach, the gateway to Menaphos and Al Kharid. My name is Ali and I'm the mayor of this town. I hope you enjoy your stay here.
Thank you. That is one of the warmest welcomes I've ever had! People generally treat travelling adventurers with suspicion.
All are welcome here. Now more than ever I suppose.
What do you mean by that?
There's trouble in town, and a lot of villagers have left as a result. Things are looking dire.
Good day old hag.
Old hag indeed! I have a name you know!
Does it happen to be... Ali?
Oh, it's actually Alisha, but they let me move in anyway. Not many hags about these days, and beggars can't be choosers!
So can I call you Al?
Only if I can call you Betty!
Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
Actually I don't want any of that stuff, I'm new in town and I wanted to get to know the locals.
I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
Sorry! I won't let it happen again.
Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
The snake charmer is focusing intently on his music and doesn't seem to notice you.
That beast would probably bite my fingers off if I tried to pet it.
If you want me to bite your fingers off, you're going the right way about it!
Hello good sir.
What do you want?
I'm new in town and wanted to get to know the locals.
What do you want to know?

column6: Tell me about the other people in the town.

column3: Tell me about yourself.
That information is available on a need to know basis and right now, you don't need to know.
Can I help you with anything else?

column4: Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.

column3: Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.
No thanks.
Tell me about the other people in the town.
Sheep, ready for the slau... hang on. I shouldn't be telling you that. Just forget I said anything.
Can I help you with anything else?

column4: Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.

column3: Hello, how's it going?
Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
Can you please help me? I'm in a terrible spot of trouble.

column4: Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.
column6: No, I'm looking for something to kill.

column3: Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.
Yes yes, I suppose it is a quest. My fiance Ernest and I came upon this house.
Seeing as we were a little lost Ernest decided to go in and ask for directions.
That was an hour ago. That house looks spooky, can you go and see if you can find him for me?
Ok, I'll see what I can do.
Thank you, thank you. I'm very grateful.
No, I'm looking for something to kill.
Oooh, you violent person you.
Be careful in here, there's lots of dangerous equipment.
What does this machine do?
Nothing at the moment... It's broken. It's meant to be a transmutation machine.
It has also spent time as a time travel machine, and a dramatic lightning generator, and a thing for generating monsters.
Is this your house?
No, I'm just one of the tenants. It belongs to the count who lives in the basement.
Are you feeling better now?
Yes, thank you.
The food you gave me healed my wounds, and it also reminded me of my family; that helped me to remember who I was.
I'm afraid that I'm trapped here, but I still remember something of this floor of the temple.
If you need any hints about the rooms nearby, I can give you some help.
It's okay, I don't need any help.
I'm sorry, but I'm currently doing some research. Could you talk to me later, please?
Okay then.
How are you and your defective brain doing nowadays, adventurer?
Hey! That's not very nice.
I'm not very nice. If you want to see who ruined all of my plans, adventurer, just look in a mirror.
Suit yourself. At least I got a nice amulet for my trouble.
About that amulet - I might be able to improve it for you, for a fee. Have you got it with you?
Yes, I've got it here.
Lazim examines the Camulet.
Yes, it's what I thought. This amulet will run out of charges all the time, if you keep using it. For one million coins I can give it unlimited charges.

column4: Why do you need so much money for it?

column3: Why do you need so much money for it?
Three reasons. Firstly, I'm a Zamorakian mage - we're not big on charity work. Secondly, I want the money. Finally, in case you need reminding, I hate you.
Right. Well, I haven't got that kind of money on me.
Maybe another time.
Hi. Interesting building you have here.
What's it for?
You like it? It's simply fabulous, isn't it? A real marvel of modern design made just for my fellow alchemists and I!
I see some builders over there. So I assume it's not yet finished.
What a keen eye this chap has! But imagine this: a gargantuan cylinder of expert design, incorporating an inventive inner spiral walkway to multiple planes of wondrous inhabitance!
So, it's a tower.
Oh, no, no, no, no.
It's going to have a use that will change this world!
Or at least it would if we could ever get it finished.
See those builders?
They don't seem to be building much.
Exactly.
They've gone on strike for some petty reason about the tower being too weird. I really can't understand those men.
Shame.
Hey! Maybe you could talk to them?
You look like a sturdy chap.
Maybe you could finish the work?
Me?
Come on! This is the chance of a lifetime!

column2: Start the Tower of Life quest?

column3: Sure, why not.
That's fantastic! Oh, I'm so pleased.
Calm down. I'm not making any promises.
Oh, I have a good feeling about this.
Right.
Go have a word with Bonafido the head builder. See if you can't get him off his backside to do some work. Oh, and I'm Effigy by the way.
Nice to meet you Effigy, I'm {name}. Hold on and I'll see what I can do!
Sorry, feeling a bit ill today.
A bit ill?
That's a weak excuse for a very feeble personality.
Hi there.
A'up, mate, how's it gowin'?
Not bad, thank you.
What are you building here?
Nowt at moment. We're on strike!
You're on strike? Whatever for?
Those strange alchemists are up ta somefin', best go ta one ov 'em.
Oh, okay.
Hi there, you mentioned something about creating monsters...?
Good! I gain know from alchemists and builders. Me make beings.
Interesting. Tell me if I'm right. By the alchemists and builders creating you, you have inherited their combined knowledge in much the same way that a child might inherit the looks of their parents.
Yes, you right!
So what do you need me to do?
Inspect symbol of life altars around dungeon. You see item give. Use item on altar. Activate altar to create, you fight.
Okay. Sounds like a challenge.
Hi there. What is this place?
Ah, this be the Tower of Life! Beautiful, isn't it?
I prefer ordinary houses.
Pah, you have no taste.
This is quite the tower.
Yeah, it cost a fair bit.
How much?
Well, I had to 'alch' a fair few belongings of my fellow alchemists to afford it.
I bet they love you for that.
Everyone loves someone that can create money.
I don't.
What's going on?
Ah, we be building this 'ere tower. Lookin' good ain't it?
It does look pretty impressive, but what are you doing hanging around?
Tea break, naturally.
Naturally. Not sure why I asked.
Fancy some?
Tea? Sure.
You'll find a kettle in the box to the-
Erm...yeah...no...sorry...gotta go.
You seem to like playing with danger, there.
They don't call me 'No-fingers' for nothing!
Well, correct me if I'm wrong, but you seem to have all your fingers.
It may seem that way mate, but I think you'll find I don't have any.
What?
These not be fingers. These 'ere be wooden fingers.
Wooden fingers?
Yep.
That's not possible, how could you move them?
Magic wood.
Yes, well I think I'd better be going now.
What are you up to?
Rock, Paper, Scissors. Can't you tell?
It was more of a rhetorical question.
Rhetora-what?
Shouldn't you be working?
We are. It's team building.
Wow, that looks pretty heavy.
Umpf! Yeah, mate...argghh...this is...umpf...hard work...
What would happen if I were to say...
Stop! Stop! Humpf...I'll beat you to...urghh...a pulp!
Okay, okay! Don't cry!
Why, I oughta...
Hello monk.
Hello adventurer. My name is Brother Kojo. Do you happen to know the time?
No, sorry, I don't.
Exactly! This clock tower has recently broken down, and without it nobody can tell the correct time. I must fix it before the town people become too angry!
I don't suppose you could assist me in the repairs? I'll pay you for your help.
OK old monk, what can I do?
Oh, thank you kind sir! In the cellar below, you'll find four cogs. They're too heavy for me, but you should be able to carry them one at a time.
I know one goes on each floor... but I can't exactly remember which goes where specifically. Oh well, I'm sure you can figure it out fairly easily.
Well, I'll do my best.
Thank you again! And remember to be careful, the cellar is full of strange beasts!
Not now old monk.
OK then. Come back and let me know if you change your mind.

column4: I've done it, I've managed to recreate the salve amulet!
column6: What powers does the salve amulet have?

column3: I've done it, I've managed to recreate the salve amulet that you spoke of.
That hardly seems likely. There is no way you could have made it to the bottom of the mines without the key which is in my possession.

column3: Who are you?
Apologies! Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Aeonisig Raispher, special advisor to King Roald on spiritual matters.
Special advisor on spiritual matters? What does that mean?
It means that some decisions the King has to make might have unforeseen repercussions on Misthalin's spiritual sensibilities. My duty is to ensure that Saradominist ideals are not stomped underfoot.
I see...
What do you do here?
My main function is to ensure that King Roald is apprised of all options, especially when it comes to any potential impacts on the righteous followers of Saradomin.
But surely the King should be able to make his own decisions on what's best for Misthalin?
What an interesting perspective you have! Totally unworkable of course, but interesting nonetheless.
Where did you come from?
I took my religious and combat training in several parts of the known world. I've also fought despicable beasts in the Wilderness in Saradomin's name.
Needless to say, I have great experience in the ways of the world and am an invaluable aid to the King's decision-making process.
How did you come to be an advisor to King Roald?
The King of Misthalin, like any great leader, always requires the best advice and the best advisors.
He very often summons occasional advisors to help him in certain situations, but it was felt by the Church of Saradomin that a full time advisor on religious matters was needed.
How come he doesn't have an advisor for any other religious denominations?
Other religious denominations? The ruling of a kingdom is no place for pagan cults and their intolerable beliefs! We do things properly here, thank you very much.
{name}.
Safalaan.

I wonder if it's the simplicity. There are no politics here. No debates. You don't need to care about good or evil, because there isn't any. Here you can just... be.

You're no monster, Safalaan.
Are you sure? How do you know I'm not about to try and eat you right now?

Safalaan!

*hmph* Like you'd be able to eat me anyway. You do remember that I'm the one that finally killed Drakan, right?

factions were eventually created, with people having different ideas on how the essence should be used (or not in some cases!)

column3: Could you tell me more about Apmeken?
Apmeken is the goddess of companionship. She is known to be the most mischievous, playful and unpredictable of the minor deities. I'd say she's my personal favourite.
So I shouldn't trust you then?
Apmeken can appeal to the most erudite scholar or the most barefaced liar. I'd like to be considered amongst the former category.
I see. What does she look like?
She has the head of a monkey, or sometimes an ape. It changes depending upon what nature she is displaying. For example, the orangutan represents wisdom, while the baboon represents mischief.
Could you tell me more about Het?
Het is the least strange of our deities to foreign eyes, for he looks just like us. I suspect this is why his shrines are particularly targeted by thieves like that infamous Templeton.
What does he represent?
Het is the god of health, both in mind and body. He is quite popular amongst soldiers as a result, especially up in Al Kharid.
Just soldiers?
Not at all! Like I said, the wellbeing of the mind is also key to Het. Many great orators also look to him for guidance. I imagine his teachings help with some of their strenuous speeches.
How did his followers react to the plagues here?
With many arguments. They really couldn't decide whether it was a punishment from Het, or an affront to him. I stayed out of that debate.
Could you tell me more about Crondis?
Crondis is a ferocious lady with the head of a mighty crocodile.
That must be awkward when buying helmets.
Luckily for her, I don't think deities have much need for them.
So what is she the goddess of?
Resourcefulness. A word which seems to be open to large interpretation.
How so?
Most consider her to be a teacher of modesty. They say we should be resourceful by only taking and using that which we absolutely need.
But there's others with a different interpretation?
Some believe she is actually the goddess of pleasure. They claim that the idea of modesty came from a misinterpretation, and that to be resourceful is to take all that you can.
That doesn't sound right.
No. It is a more recent take that I suspect was born in Menaphos. There are many in that city with more wealth than they'll ever need. Modesty is not an ideal they'll ever embody.
Could you tell me more about Scabaras?
There are many opinions out there on Scabaras, but general knowledge isn't always the most accurate.
Well what are the absolute facts then?
Scabaras is the god of isolation. He takes on the appearance of a man with the head of a scarab. Both he and his followers were driven into hiding long ago.
And?
And that's it. You asked for the absolute facts. Anything beyond that is just speculation.
But there must be more. The High Priest told me that Scabaras tried to conquer these lands.
So it is said, but the written accounts that exist contain many inconsistencies when it comes to what role Scabaras actually played. Of course, most would not know that.
How come?
Many of the writings are only available to us priests. That does of course include the new High Priest, but perhaps he is yet to read them. They are definitely... illuminating.
Interesting...
Interesting. Thanks for the information.
I'd better get going.
You're back! I just had an interesting chat with a group of lesser gods. Seems you dealt a heavy blow to the Devourer and made some powerful new friends in the process.
It didn't go perfectly. Amascut still escaped, and she'd already gained a fair amount of power by that point.
True, but things could have wound up going a lot worse. You're right though, this is clearly far from over.

Most likely. She didn't go to all the effort of causing those plagues for nothing. This tomb was clearly only part of her plan.
Still, she'll need to reconsider her strategy after her defeat. We have a little time now.

The lesser gods were under the Devourer's control for a long time, and a lot's changed since they disappeared. I've offered to help them where I can.

Maisa gives you an antique lamp.

Okay then.
Here you go... Hic!

...it tastes horrific and burns your throat.

75 coins pleashe.

No thanks.

And yourself.

Oh, I see.
Hi cat!
Miaooow!
Who's a cute little kitty?
Miaow!
Hello. How are you?
I've been better.
What's wrong?
You may or may not be aware, but a plague has spread across West Ardougne. Now, so far, our efforts to contain it have been largely successful, for the most part.
However, some sheep recently escaped from a farm near the city. When they were found, we noticed that they were strangely discoloured, so we asked the mourners to examine them.
They believe that the sheep have become infected with the plague.
Are you sure it's the plague?
Well the mourners seemed convinced and they're the experts. Even if it's not though, the sheep are clearly diseased in some way.
As the councillor responsible for public health and safety here in East Ardougne, I am in charge of dealing with this problem.
We need someone to herd these sheep into a safe enclosure, kill them quickly and cleanly and then dispose of the remains hygienically in a special incinerator.
Unfortunately, nobody wants to risk catching the plague, and I am unable to find someone willing to undertake this mission for me.
I can do that for you.
You will? That is excellent news! Head to the enclosure we have set up on Farmer Brumty's land to the north of the city; the four infected sheep should still be somewhere in that vicinity.
Before you will be allowed to enter the enclosure, however, you must ensure you have some kind of protective clothing to prevent contagion.
Where can I find some protective clothing then?
Doctor Orbon should have something suitable. You should be able to find him in the chapel just north of here.
Please also take this poisoned sheep feed; we believe poisoning the sheep will minimise the risk of airborne contamination, and is of course also more humane to the sheep.
The councillor gives you some poisoned sheep feed.
How will I know which sheep are infected?
The poor creatures have developed strangely discoloured wool and flesh. You should have no trouble spotting them. There should be four in total.
That's not a job for me.
I do not blame you adventurer. It is not particularly pleasant work. My problem remains however. If you know of anyone suitable please send them this way; time is of the essence.
That's life for you.
That's what concerns me... There might not be much life around here soon.
Silver! Silver! Best prices for buying and selling in all Kandarin!
Yes please.
No thank you.
Hello there! I sell plate mail bodies, are you interested?
Sorry, I'm not interested.
'Ello 'Ello!
Who's this then?
I don't know any more than you do!
Well ask them!
You ask them!
No! I'm not talking to some stranger in a sewer.
Go away, weirdo! We're busy!
Hello.

No.

Hello.

They're tougher, stronger and faster than other kinds of cats. They have superior hunting skills and can even catch butterflies and kalphite larvae.
So are there any drawbacks to owning them?
Wily cats need lots more exercise, otherwise they'll get fat and lazy.
What's the best way to exercise them?
Bring it hunting or take it to the Rat Pits regularly.
Try and keep it happy too, wily cats can be a little nasty when they're cranky.

It'll get fat and lazy and become much worse at hunting. Plus, everyone will know you're a bad cat trainer.

Nardarine came from a town towards the north side of the desert which does not exist today. This was in the third age in the time thou callest
the God Wars. Her town was once controlled by Saradomin, but there was a great battle there between Saradominist and Zamorakian forces which pretty much levelled the town

restored.

This dates back to the times when there was much in-fighting amongst the noble families and their clans, and was introduced as a way of reducing the bloodshed that was devestating the ranks of the ruling classes at that
time. When you captured a rival family's clan, you also captured their lands and wealth.

column3: How do I play board games?
You can challenge someone to a game anywhere in the Games Zone (except on a PvP or Deadman world) by using the right click option.
Choose the type of game and then choose the options you want such as time per move.
If your opponent accepts the challenge you will be taken to one of the tables around where you will play your game of choice.
Once you have finished your game you will come back here where you can challenge again! We also have tables in a few pubs around the world!
What games can I play?
Currently we offer Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares, and Runeversi.
Draughts?
Draughts uses standard rules, apart from: a draw is declared if no piece has been taken or promoted for forty moves.
Runelink?
Yup, you have to get four runes in row.
Runesquares?
Yes, you take it in turns to add a line with the goal of making squares. Everytime you make a square you take another turn.
Runeversi?
Yep, the aim is to have more of your runes on the board than your opponent. You can take your opponents pieces by trapping them between your own.
Can I buy a drink please?
I'm afraid I don't sell drinks.
Thanks!
