The Yorkie heads to the dog shelter.
Thank you once again, adventurer. You've really given us hope to keep going.
Happy to help!
Wonderful, because our work has just begun!
Huh?
Word has spread of our shelter and we've received letters about stray dogs across the world.
Chase has been keeping a log of all the reports. If you speak with him, he'll show you.
What's in it for me?
Well, you'll be able to adopt any puppies you bring back.
Hello there, Chase. Could I adopt a puppy?
If you want to.
Who are you?
Kayer... Pete Kayer. It is a pleasure to meet your acquaintance. I've settled in the Ferox Enclave to offer my expertise to passersby.
What expertise?
I'm a master of survival and an esteemed hunter. Specifically, I very much know a thing or two about surviving the Wilderness.
Why are you offering knowledge? Do you require gold?
I've seen my fair share of friendly folk perish. It's time to empower those that dare enter the Wilderness to give them a fighting chance.
I need not be paid, for I have made my fortunes from those who hunt the weak.
Can you teach me?
Of course, but I believe actions speak louder than words, so we will have to go to my private arena.
You like to hunt, are familiar with the Wilderness and want me to follow you... This seems rather suspicious Pete.
Don't worry, I'll lend you some gear to use, and if you mess up, nothing bad will happen to you.
Well, in that case, what's not to trust. What challenges do you have available for me?
Can you prove your skills?
You... Who are you? And how did you get in here?
Human... You stand before Ocellus... Chosen... of Guthix...
You serve Guthix?
Yes... He charged me... to guard the source of his power... But his enemies approach... They are not worthy of it...
Well, then we're on the same side. I'm part of an alliance defending this place. The danger is mostly gone though. We held off the attackers.
No... Your alliance... is false... Armadyl... Saradomin... They are no better... than the rest... They are not worthy... of this power...
We don't want it! We just want to keep this place safe!
Wrong... Many try... but none can resist... You will try to take it... His blade...
There is only one solution... Only Guthix himself is worthy... but he is long gone...
To keep his power safe... I will take his place...
The time has come... for ascension.
Hello.
Hello?
Hmm? What what?
I hope I'm not interrupting.
Interrupting who?
You?
What about me?
Am I interrupting you?
I'm not sure... What is it you're interrupting me for?
Well, I was just going to ask what you're doing, but I'm starting to regret it.
Why didn't you say so, my boy!
I... am... the Keeper of the Records!
You're a record keeper?
THE Record Keeper!
These sensitive records are under my precise curation!
The secrets of the Archive, the progress of the Alliance, the very steps you took towards me today, all recorded in these... very... pages!
Can I have a loo-
No!
Sorry, I was just interested.
Hmm... I suppose you may view some of the records, should your curiosity need satisfying.
What are you doing?
I... am... the Keeper of the Records!
You're a record keeper?
THE Record Keeper!
These sensitive records are under my precise curation!
Can I have a loo-
No!
Sorry, I was just interested.
Hmm... I suppose you may view some of the records, should your curiosity need satisfying.
How are things?
The Alliance is struggling to hold off the threats to the Archive. And the records are eager to chronicle your deeds in this matter, if you are so inclined.
You may view some of the records, should your curiosity need satisfying.
Goodbye.
Fare-thee-well, Aspirant, we watch you with great interest.
Hello.
Hello!
Who are you?
I am the record keeper's... yes 'the' record keeper's... apprentice.
The record keeper is a wizard?
No, I'm a wizard, and his apprentice separately.
Oh... I see. And what do you do here?
I record the Archive's effects on its surroundings. Namely, the changes in those big crystals behind you.
That sounds interesting. Can I help somehow?
Why yes you can! The latent magical energy of the Archive collects in these crystals, and they seem to react to impact in interesting ways.
So you want me to mine the rocks?
Yes! Exactly.
Oh...
Oh?
I thought the work would be more... scientific.
Oh but it is! Their reactions are incredible! For example, hitting the rock will occasionally cause nearby ambient magic to collate into what I'm calling a sprite.
The sprite is not a liquid, gas or a solid. It is the magical state of the crystal rocks! How exciting is that?! A material with a magical state!
That sounds quite interesting actually.
Yes! And what is more, merely noticing the sprite will cause it to immediately change into its solid crystal form, gravitating towards the source of attention.
That's incredible!

Ahaha, now you see the value of the work. But that's not all! The root system of the Archive seems to be trying to keep the crystals bound. But if the crystals are broken down enough, the roots retreat.
Sentient roots?!
Well, that's what we're here to find out! Without the roots, the crystals are fully exposed for collection.
And should I bring you back what I mine?
No, no, I have no use for rocks. Keep them! They're densely magical, I'm sure you can find some use for them.
Okay, thanks. I think I'll give that a go.
Oh, hello. How can I help?

column4: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
column6: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
column10: I'd like to buy more bank slots.

column3: What's your function here?
I'm the Alliance's travelling liaison with the Bank of Gielinor. I make sure everybody has everything they need, wherever we go.
Must be nice getting to travel around for work.
I'd enjoy it a lot more if our destinations weren't generally so dangerous, but yes, I like seeing the world.
What's the book for then?
Once we're settled in, my job involves a lot of standing around. There's only so much you can appreciate a cavern, even one as impressive as this.
That makes sense. And what's the book about?
It's a collection of poems believed to be from the Second Age.
Interesting. Could you read me one?
Of course.
'Flowers wilt and grow. Pruned carefully as they go. Were it that this flower, could live a life its own.'
I'm not sure I understand.
There's no real need to. It's just a poem.
So it has no meaning?
It means something to me.
Okay, what does it mean to you?
Hmm... I suppose it's a reflection on the way our surroundings shape us. Or maybe it's arguing that wilder gardens are more beautiful.
Maybe... I think I'll leave you to your reading now.
Of course. Let me know if you need anything else.
Hello!
Good day!
What do you do here?
I organise people according to the Alliance's defence plans. That means bringing newcomers quickly up to speed, and communicating any changes to the plan across the troops.

column4: Tell me more about the Archive.

column3: Tell me more about the Archive.

You can see the Archive's layout on the board beside me. The central chamber, which we're calling the Nexus, is currently occupied by a hostile automaton. We plan to take that chamber and establish our defence
there.
And by 'we' you mean me?
Indeed. Before he left, Armacus informed me you would clear the way whilst he and the others mobilised the rest of the troops.
He did, did he?
Yes! He seemed confident you would help. 'I can see it in his eyes. The flame of justice!'
He is a bit eccentric, but he is a fine leader, and a good judge of character.
At least one of those is true. What comes after the Nexus?
There are six peripheral chambers we expect to come under attack, all of which can be reached from the Nexus. As soon as the Nexus is secured, we will begin deploying troops to the furthest chambers.
They will hold the line whilst we work on clearing the foremost ones. We are relying on you to take one side whilst we take the other.
So that makes... the Nexus plus three chambers you want taking care of?
Yes. It is no small ask, but we do not think we can manage any more ourselves. I would suggest you seek allies of your own to help you.
I'll see what I can do.
Who are our enemies?
We have followers of Lucien, Zamorak and Bandos to deal with. Evidence also suggests there are other foes yet to fully reveal themselves. For example, there have been reports of a lone knight.
A lone knight?
Yes. The scouting report is spotty. Only one of our people made it back alive, but they were heavily wounded. Apparently this knight took out a whole squadron by himself.
That's concerning... What about the others?

The Bandosian forces are mostly goblins. You wouldn't think they'd pose much of a threat, but they've managed to build some sort of siege engine. If that weren't enough, they're being lead by a huge ork.
As for the forces of Lucien and Zamorak, we spotted a clash between the two factions in some of the deeper tunnels. An army of skeletons facing off against a group of Zamorakian mages.
The Dagon'hai?
Interestingly, no, but we'll get to them. We managed to capture one of the mages and interrogate them. They refused to say much, but we gather they're trying to summon some sort of powerful demon.
And the skeletons?
There seems to be an endless tide of them. A necromancer must be present. It's possible this is the work of Moia, the leader of Lucien's forces.
And let me guess, there's more?
Quite... You mentioned the Dagon'hai. A group of them were spotted near the Stone of Jas' old location. They seemed to be fending off an unusually capable tormented demon.
In what way?
Most tormented demons seem to struggle with the strength of their own flames. This one seemed to fully control them, lending it both greater power and durability.
Did it manage to get rid of the Dagon'hai?
No, they disengaged and made for a tunnel we think leads to the Archive. The demon followed, but went down a different path.
That's quite the list we're up against.
Yes... but we are not without allies either. The Alliance is rallying as we speak. Together we can do this.
Where is everybody else?
Armacus, Eva and Ivy have gone to rally the rest of the forces. We are only a small vanguard sent to assess the situation and prepare if necessary.
Let's hope they don't take too long.
Fear not, they will soon return with help. Once they are here, we estimate we can defeat three sets of intruders. As for the rest... we will be relying on you and any allies you can gather yourself.
Thank you.
It was my pleasure, {name}. Good luck in there.
Hello!
Ah, hello! We've managed to resupply, if you'd like to take a look?
I'd like to resupply.
Very good.
Who are you?
My name is Liam, the Quartermaster. I don't engage in combat anymore, but I'm here to support others that do.
I'm fine for now, thanks.
Of course. Do bear in mind that our stock runs low rather quickly, so opportunities to resupply are limited.
I'll keep that in mind.
Greetings, mortal.

column6: Tell me more about Hardcore Mode.

column3: Who are you?
I am a headhunter of sorts. My master seeks fresh adventurers for his challenge. The brave, the reckless, the prodigial.
How about all three?
Very good. Death would be pleased with me for bringing you in.
Wait... Death...? As in The Death? The one who awaits at the end of all roads?
Indeed. The one and only. He wishes for participants for his Hardcore Mode challenge. What say you now, {name}?
Tell me more about Hardcore Mode.
In Hardcore Mode you play on worlds that only Hardcore players may access.
These worlds have their own economy, separate from other worlds. However, while on them, you only have one life.
Should you lose the challenge, you may continue your journey on Non-Hardcore worlds, keeping most of your items and stats.
Upon dying, you will lose everything on your person, except protected items. Other items, like the ones in your bank, are protected.

If you are not easily dissuaded by such setbacks, you may choose to fully reset your progress. You will have a fresh start, wiping all your items, stats and progress, but retaining access to Hardcore worlds.
Note that Death counts any death as a failure. A Brutal Hardcore ruleset, if you will.
So, what say you, {name}? Will you accept Death's challenge and become a Hardcore player?
Why are you here?
My master, Death, has trusted me with seeking out promising adventurers for his challenge.
And what does he get out of it?
Over the years, he has made his rules more lenient for the adventurers of the world. Death storage, gravestones, lenience on fees...
He is kind, at heart. He does not wish to walk back these changes, but he misses being able to watch a world where people tread carefully around danger.
So this is his compromise. A set of more dangerous worlds for those who can handle them.
Oh, hello there. What brings you here?
I'm just looking around.
Oh... Fair enough...
Adventurer.
How are things going?
Well, this is Kourend, so there's never any shortage of work to be doing. We've had three murders in the past couple of days alone.
Any interesting ones?
Like the Betty case? No, just a few robberies gone wrong in Piscarilius.
Maybe I could help you out with one of them?
Thank you for the offer, but I think it would be best if you left the investigating to us this time.
Fair enough.
Could I have another amulet?
You can, but it will cost you 1,500 coins.
Ah, I don't have enough on me. Never mind.
I'd best get going.
Hello there.
Saradomin be with you, stranger.
Hello.
Hello there. Good day for farming, isn't it?
Yes, I suppose so.
Too right.
Hello there.
Hi.
Not one for talking?
No.
Fair enough.
